name: WIN_VIP Account Disabled
description: Alerta para quando é desativada a conta de um usuário VIP.
alert_description: A conta VIP $TargetUserName foi desativada no host $agent_hostname com o IP $agent_ip_addresses . Detalhes do evento: $action_evtlog_message (Event ID: $action_evtlog_event_id ). Recomenda-se a investigação imediata para validar a legitimidade desta ação.
investigation_query_link:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.EVENT_LOG AND action_evtlog_event_id = 4725
| alter TargetUserName = trim(json_extract(action_evtlog_data_fields,"$.TargetUserName"),"\"")
| join type = inner conflict_strategy = both (
    dataset = vip_users
    | fields SAM
) as vip vip.SAM = TargetUserName
| fields _time, agent_hostname, TargetUserName, agent_ip_addresses, action_evtlog_message, action_evtlog_event_id
